description: Where every placed part's pins land, as [column, row] holes, with pin numbers and labels (e.g. U1 pin 8 VCC), after rotation, plus holes a part's body covers. Use it to route wires to the right holes. The project file doesn't store these: they follow from each part's anchor, rotation and footprint.

project.description: The whole project file: a version 3 project object, or its JSON text (see the perfboard://docs/project-file resource). Give this or projectId.

projectId.description: The id of a project kept here (from new_project, validate_project, edit_project or read_share_link), instead of sending the whole project.

refs.description: Only these parts, e.g. ["U1", "R2"]. All parts when omitted.

name: get_pin_positions
title: Get pin positions
